reasoning_content: Let's take a look at the FeatureType section of the WFS capabilities.

action.command:
python3 -c "
import re
d=open('/tmp/caps52.xml').read()
i=d.find('Contents')
seg=d[i:i+3000]
m=re.findall(r'<TypeName>([^<]*)</TypeName>',seg)
if not m:
    # WFS 2.0 uses qname attr
    m=re.findall(r'name=\"([^\"]+)\"',seg)
print('TYPES:',m[:8])
print(seg[:1200])
"
